summary: Griffon Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $800 million private placement of 6.25% senior notes due 2034. The notes were sold under a purchase agreement dated August 10, 2026, with BofA Securities as representative of the initial purchasers, and are governed by an indenture with Computershare Trust Company as trustee. Net proceeds were approximately $792 million. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with subsidiary guarantees. This is an ordinary debt financing event, not a special situation.
